title: Business Refund on Closure: Closure Core and Business Cash Recovery
content:
**Clause.** On the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships handled by the Business closure schedule, the Business refund refers to the most recent settled annual fee charge on the membership. When the membership carries no settled annual fee charge, nothing is refunded.

The Business refund is the closure core less the Business Cash recovery, never more than that fee and never below zero, rounded down to the cent. When the refund comes to zero, the cancellation is still recorded and confirmed, and no refund entry is booked.

1. **Closure core.** The prorated fee: the fee multiplied by the whole calendar months from the cancellation date to the renewal date, divided by the tier's paid term in months. A whole calendar month is counted when the renewal date reaches the same day of the month as the cancellation date.
2. **Business Cash recovery.** The Business-rate Northgate Cash of the twelve whole calendar months before the cancellation date, never below zero and rounded half up to the cent.
   - The Business-rate Cash is the net Business Cash minus the Rewards-rate Cash.
   - The net Business Cash is the Cash earned in that period minus the Cash reversed in that period.
   - The Rewards-rate Cash is 1 percent, the Northgate Rewards rate, of the net Business basis.
   - The net Business basis is the earning bases of that period minus the reversal bases of that period.

The period covers the Northgate Cash earnings and reversals on the membership's ledger dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by the cancellation date; an earning's basis is the earning basis recorded on it and a reversal's basis is the refunded merchandise recorded on it. The Business Cash recovery is rounded half up to the cent on its own; the closure core less the recovery is then capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures chosen for round arithmetic; fee 120.00 on a 12-month term)**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| whole calendar months to the renewal date | 9 |
| closure core | 120.00 multiplied by 9, divided by 12, that is 90.00 |
| Cash earned in the period, on earning bases of | 14.00 on 700.00 |
| Cash reversed in the period, on reversal bases of | 2.00 on 100.00 |
| net Business Cash | 12.00 |
| net Business basis | 600.00 |
| Rewards-rate Cash | 1 percent of 600.00, that is 6.00 |
| Business Cash recovery | 12.00 less 6.00, that is 6.00 |
| Business refund | 90.00 less 6.00, that is 84.00 |
